title: AP decisions & schemes: Dec 2025-Feb 2026
quote: 2026 declared the "Year of Land Reforms" in Andhra Pradesh

boxes.title: Land reforms: Section 22-A
items: **Five** categories removed from prohibited list (**Registration Act**)
Removed: **defence** personnel, **freedom fighters**, **political victims**, pre-**18 June 1954** assignments, **private patta**
⚠ ==**Conditional patta** not removed==; GoM to decide
**21.8 lakh** pattadar passbooks, **1-9 January 2026**
**AI and Blockchain**, auto-mutation; Collectors cancel fake registrations

boxes.title: Cabinet & governance
items: **AP AI Living Labs**: **Section-8** non-profit; AI training for one per family (**11 Feb 2026**)
MLAs: ==**digital/biometric attendance**==; Art **190**: seat vacant after **60 days** absence
Zero excise on **raw tobacco** (HS **2401**) from **1 Feb 2026**: by ==**Finance Ministry**==
**Census 2027** Phase 1 (HLO): **1 April-30 September 2026**
**P4**: Margadarsis help **Bangaru Mitras**; ⚠ not infra PPP

boxes.title: Police & welfare drives
items: **Visakhapatnam**: ==Safest City for Women== (**NARI 2025**)
**Operation Chinnari-Thalli**: crimes on children; **POCSO** charge sheet in **60 days**
**Operation Vajra Prahar** (Nellore): anti-drug; **AP Eagle 1972**
Anganwadi: **5G** phones to **58,204** workers
AIDS-free AP by **2030**; ⚠ AP **second-highest** HIV prevalence

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Tobacco duty notified by **Finance Ministry** (CBIC), not Agriculture
"Clicker" system = ==classroom engagement==, not attendance
Delimitation ==follows== Census 2027; last census **2011**
First Cocoa City near **Eluru**; saffron trial at **Lambasingi**
Natural farming at Davos: **18 lakh** farmers, **20 lakh acres**; ⚠ low-cost
